"Hey there gate team,"
Mid-morning, the arrivals lead reviewed a thought on paperwork queues and asked that we keep our handling notes clear and calm for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Please continue to direct any companion animal cases through the usual review path so the passenger coordinator can confirm the required travel steps before escort handoff. Keep carriers level during transfer, speak to passengers in a steady manner, and avoid offering any assurance that is not yet confirmed. For cat travel, <<FACT F079>> and the certificate should be checked carefully with the rest of the file.

If you see a delay in the flow, notify the senior coordinator at once so we can keep guidance consistent and protect the comfort of the animal and the traveler. Your steady attention supports a smoother experience for everyone involved and helps maintain confidence at the service point.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
